text: When an xc7s50 64-DSP matmul is timing-limited at 196 MHz by a fully combinational multiply-accumulate path (4.97 ns, dsp_regs=none), switch dsp_regs to in_pipe_out to break the DSP48E1 M-to-P/CARRY4 chain internally, raising Fmax to 227 MHz (+31.2 MHz) while keeping 64 MAC/cycle and adding only 1 LUT.

When an XC7S50 fully DSP-registered matmul is feasible at 227.38 MHz with 1325 LUT and a 32-bit accumulator, reduce acc_width to 24 (the legal minimum) to cut LUT to 1005 and raise Fmax to 239.64 MHz (+12.3) by shortening the accumulator carry/register path (critical path 4.25→4.17 ns), while keeping 64 DSP and 64 MAC/cycle.

On xc7s50 matmul, when 8x8 PEs demand 64 DSP48E1s (over the 32-DSP budget) and the 4.95 ns critical path is a 4.01 ns combinational DSP48E1 acc0, halve pe_cols to 4 and set dsp_regs to 'in_pipe_out' to fit 32 DSPs and pipeline the multiply-accumulate, yielding 278.16 MHz (+88.4 MHz) and 905 fewer LUTs.

When an XC7S50 32-DSP matmul is timing-limited inside the DSP48E1 accumulator, do not trim acc_width from 32 to 24 to shorten the post-adder carry chain: it saved 96 LUTs but dropped Fmax from 278.16 to 264.62 MHz (Δ−13.5 MHz) with the critical path still in the DSP48E1 acc0 and zero route delay, so the narrower accumulator did not shorten the limiting DSP path.

On xc7s50 matmul, when the critical path is the DSP48E1 internal M->P accumulate stage (2.31 ns) with dsp_regs already maxed, do not insert a fabric register via pipe_mul=1 between the multiplier and accumulator: it doubles DSPs from 32 to 64 and drops Fmax from 264.6 to 224.7 MHz because the added FDRE/route remains on the path instead of splitting the DSP M+P stage.

When an XC7S50 matmul is DSP-critical with pipe_mul=1 forcing 2 DSP/PE at 224.7 MHz, halve the 8x4 PE array to 4x4 and set pipe_mul=0 to cut DSPs 64->16 and LUTs 322->213, shrinking operand-broadcast/fanout loading on the DSP acc0 stage so Fmax rises +39.3 MHz to 264.0 MHz (path 4.3->3.47 ns), though 300 MHz still needs the 2.31 ns DSP MAC internal path split.

When an xc7s50 matmul is timing-limited at 264 MHz by the DSP48E1 internal accumulate path (2.31 ns logic of a 3.47 ns path), move to 8x4 PEs with acc_width=32 and reg_in=true, adding 16 DSPs and 205 LUTs to reach 276 MHz (+11.9 MHz), but keep in mind the unchanged 2.31 ns DSP-internal accumulate still keeps it below 300 MHz, so do not rely on array-shape/input-register changes alone to fix DSP-internal accumulation.

When an XC7S50 matmul with acc-in-DSP and dsp-registered in_pipe_out is timing-limited by the DSP48E1 post-adder at ~2.31 ns, keep acc_width at 32 rather than raising it to 48, because 48 bits only added 579 LUTs and dropped Fmax from 275.94 to 274.73 MHz without moving the DSP critical path.

When an XC7S50 matmul PE array is DSP-budget and timing limited by a 4.95 ns DSP48E1 acc_n path from dsp_regs=none plus acc_in_dsp=true, set dsp_regs=in_pipe_out, acc_in_dsp=false, reshape 8x4 to 4x8, and drop acc_width 32→24; this retimes the DSP and moves the post-add to a shorter fabric CARRY4 path, raising Fmax 189.75→299.94 MHz (+110.2, still just under 300 MHz) while halving DSPs 64→32 for +658 LUTs.

When a DSP-registered, fabric-accumulator matmul on XC7S50 misses timing at 299.9 MHz on route-dominated high-fanout drain/skew chains, reshape the 4x8 PE array to 2x16 with the same 32 MAC/cycle and 32 DSPs to halve pe_rows and shorten those chains (+19.6 MHz, 319.5 MHz feasible).

When your xc7s50 matmul is timing-limited by the unregistered DSP48E1 acc_n combinational path (4.01 ns) and 64 PEs exceed the 48-DSP budget, retime with dsp_regs=in_pipe_out, acc_in_dsp=false, shorten acc_width 32->24 to trim the fabric CARRY4 accumulator chain, and cut pe_rows 8->6 (48 PEs), lifting Fmax 189.75->295.33 MHz.

When the 6x8 matmul on XC7S50 is feasible at 295.33 MHz but uses 2965 LUTs with a route-dominated FDRE(v_skew)->LUT3(acc)->FDRE(acc) path, do not switch acc_in_dsp=true and reshape to 2x24 to save LUTs, because the DSP48E1 M->P post-adder path (2.31 ns) becomes critical and drops Fmax to 264.55 MHz (-30.8 MHz), cutting LUTs to 635 but losing feasibility.

When the xc7s50 matmul is timing-limited inside the DSP48E1 accumulator (2.31 ns logic of a 3.46 ns path) and DSP count is already pinned at 48, move the accumulator out of the DSP and reshape the PE array to taller/narrower (4x12) at the same 48 PEs so the critical path shifts onto fabric LUT-to-FDRE routing, buying +28.5 MHz (264.6 to 293.1) and feasibility at the cost of +2332 LUTs (635 to 2967).
